# Triple A Interiors

> Triple A Interiors is a Dubai-based interior fit-out and turnkey contractor delivering luxury commercial and residential interiors across the UAE — from concept and design through MEP, joinery, finishes, authority approvals and handover.

Triple A Interiors (legal name: Triple A Interior Fit-Out) was founded in 2015 and is based in Al Garhoud, Dubai. The company handles both residential and commercial projects — apartments, villas, corporate offices, retail and hospitality — and manages the full project lifecycle in-house, including Dubai Municipality, DEWA and Civil Defence approvals. Past clients include Emaar, Meraas and Wood Group, with delivered projects across Dubai, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah.

## Key facts
- Service: Interior fit-out, MEP contracting, renovations, and turnkey interior solutions
- Location: Fronds Building, M06, Sheikh Rashid Road, Al Garhoud, Dubai, UAE
- Area served: Dubai, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, and the wider UAE (plus remote clients via virtual consultation)
- Founded: 2015
- Typical project duration: 2–6 months depending on scope and unit size
- Typical Dubai fit-out cost: ~AED 500/sqm (basic) to AED 5,000+/sqm (luxury)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 58 550 0359
- Email: info@triple-a.ae
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aaa_fitout/

## Services
- [Interior Fit-Out](https://triple-a.ae/services): End-to-end fit-out for commercial and residential spaces — MEP, partitions, ceilings, finishes and joinery from concept to handover.
- [MEP Contracting](https://triple-a.ae/services): Mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems (HVAC, power, lighting, drainage, fire safety) compliant with DEWA and Dubai Municipality standards.
- [Full & Partial Renovations](https://triple-a.ae/services): Renovations of apartments, villas and offices, from structural changes to finishes.
- [Authority Approvals](https://triple-a.ae/services): Dubai Municipality, DEWA and Dubai Civil Defence permits and inspections.
- [Ceiling Works](https://triple-a.ae/services): Gypsum, suspended, acoustic and wooden ceiling systems with integrated lighting and HVAC.
- [Wall Finishes & Cladding](https://triple-a.ae/services): Paint, natural stone, wood and tile finishes and cladding.
- [Flooring Solutions](https://triple-a.ae/services): Porcelain, natural stone, hardwood, luxury vinyl and epoxy flooring.

## Selected projects
- [Wood Group Corporate Office Fit-out](https://triple-a.ae/projects/wood-group-corporate-office-fitout): Commercial fit-out with advanced MEP and acoustic glass partitions (Sharjah).
- [Forma Studio Office Design](https://triple-a.ae/projects/forma-studio-architecture-office-design): Minimalist commercial fit-out with custom metal joinery (JVC, Dubai).
- [Celadon Central Park by Meraas](https://triple-a.ae/projects/celadon-central-park-residential-buildings): High-spec residential fit-out with marble finishes and smart-home automation (City Walk, Dubai).
- [Emaar Executive Interior](https://triple-a.ae/projects/emaar-villas-luxury-interior-design): Luxury executive office interior with recessed lighting and walnut detailing (Dubai).
- [JVC Apartment Renovation](https://triple-a.ae/projects/jvc-apartment-renovation): Residential apartment renovation with custom timber joinery (JVC, Dubai).
- [Marbilla Villa Renovation](https://triple-a.ae/projects/marbilla-villa-renovation): Experiential villa fit-out with bespoke joinery (Ras Al Khaimah).
